statement: In the actual eight-point pure mapping class completion of F12-F15, an explicit discrete iterated commutator centralizes the specified involution, is killed by every one-point and every proper labelled forgetting map, and generates a full closed Zhat. Its closure lies in C_B(R) and meets the original curve image trivially. Consequently the pullback of all proper forgetting images strictly contains that curve image, and remains strictly larger after imposing R-centralization. The same procyclic subgroup gives an exact ambiguity inside every centralizing correction coset.
depends_on: F7.4-5 actual prime-order normalizer sequence and full induced topology; F12 actual based involution and labelled curve image; F14 injective ordinary-point forgetting composite and completed Birman topology; F15 exact subgroup B and correction cosets; the explicit branched double-cover annulus calculation, free-basis point pushing, and integral unitriangular detector proved here
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part F(b), exact residual centralizer and the common-involution source-membership problem.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The quotient function, its two branch labels and four ordinary orbit labels, all eight original label fibres, the actual branch-point-pushing kernel, the pure lift and its covering degree, and the full completion maps are specified.
computational_checks: code/part_a/common_reflection_forgetting_ambiguity_f16.py and adjacent JSON/stdout execute 5,007 exact checks: the actual label pairs, eight individual and 255 proper word-forgetting substitutions, degree-two annulus formulas, the integer U5 value I+16E15, and power/order formulas in 21 finite primary reductions.
notes: The explicit word is [[[b0,b1],b2],b3], where bi is the pure lift of the square of the actual branch-point-pushing generator mi. Its quotient word maps to I+16E15 in U5(Zhat), and the completed Birman embedding transports this detector to the actual subgroup. Multiplication by 16 on Zhat is injective, including at two. The claim refutes only the displayed image-membership test using proper forgetting maps, even together with centralization. It does not provide a nonidentity element in the original source equalizer or settle the residual A5 centralizer.
